purpose: Define named read-only inputs that can be selected by Projector, Mapper, Planner comparison and future Structure tools without duplicating source configuration.
invariants: Every input has a stable id and human-readable name.
Every projection instance references exactly one input_id.
Input source configuration is owned by the Inputs registry, never copied into projection semantics.
Input roles are presentation/organization metadata and do not create semantic relations.
Input detectors may emit only source-proven facts.
Two input scopes MUST NOT overlap.
Multiple projections may reference the same input.
Different inputs are not automatically related even if their node identities or names match.

fields.name: Human-readable input name.
fields.role: Organizational role such as specification, code, reference, data or other. Role is non-semantic.
fields.repository: Read-only repository identity in owner/repository form.
fields.branch: Mutable source selector resolved to an immutable revision before parsing.
fields.directory: Optional explicit repository-relative read scope. Required when another input shares the repository.
fields.path: Optional detector-specific path inside the input scope, for example a single Raw JSON file.
fields.enabled: Whether the input is currently available for projection selection.

projection_binding.rule: The selected input determines the StructureTree/topic catalog used by that projection instance.

organization.projector: Projection instances SHOULD be grouped by input in the UI.
organization.selector: Input selectors SHOULD group inputs by role and show the input name.
organization.semantics: Grouping is viewer organization only and never source semantics.
